# GradientEditor

**Class:** `UltraCanvasGradientEditor` · **Group:** [Buttons and choices](../Groups/Buttons-and-choices.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasGradientEditor.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasGradientEditor.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasGradientEditor.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

The stops of a gradient (a colour ramp)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasGradientEditor](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasGradientEditor.md)
- [UltraCanvasVectorCanvas](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasVectorCanvas.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGradientEditor> CreateGradientEditor(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
explicit UltraCanvasGradientEditor(const std::string& elemId = "GradientEditor", int x = 0, int y = 0, int width = 240, int height = 44);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onStopsChanged` | `std::function<void()> onStopsChanged` | any edit (position, colour, add, remove) |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(int)> onSelectionChanged` | selected stop index, -1 for none |
| `onStopsChanging` | `std::function<void()> onStopsChanging` | Fires while a stop is being dragged (for a live preview); onStopsChanged fires once on release as well. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetStops` | `void SetStops(const std::vector<GradientStop>& stops)` | Stops are kept sorted by position; the first and last may not be removed (a gradient needs two). |
| `AddStop` | `int AddStop(double position, const Color& color)` | returns the new index |
| `AddStopAt` | `int AddStopAt(double position)` | Adds a stop at `position` with the ramp's colour there. |
